findings.title: Materials' 55-point lens gap signals distress
findings.body: Materials trades at 16.76x forward but 35.49x trailing, a 53 percent compression that implies 112 percent earnings growth. That gap is the widest in the table and suggests the market is pricing a dramatic earnings recovery that has not yet appeared in reported results.

findings.title: Health Care's rich forward multiple defies history
findings.body: Health Care's forward P/E sits at the 97th percentile of its five-year range while its trailing multiple is only at the 76th. The 44 percent compression implies 79 percent earnings growth, a bet that margins will expand sharply from already elevated levels.

findings.title: Utilities' forward multiple outruns its earnings
findings.body: Utilities trades at 17.45x forward versus 18.12x trailing, a mere 4 percent compression that implies just 4 percent earnings growth. Yet its forward percentile is 27 while its trailing percentile is 2, meaning the market has re-rated the sector on expectations that reported earnings have not yet justified.
